display_name: Zuora: Get Credit Memo Apply Job
description: Read an asynchronous credit memo apply job (GET /v1/credit-memos/apply-async-jobs/{applyAsyncJobId}): its status and errors. Returns job_id/status queued at once; dispatch is not completion.
embedding_description: Follow up on a large credit being spread across many open invoices in the background: is the settlement job still running, done, or did some invoices fail to receive credit? Use after a bulk asynchronous credit application so you know when customer balances are actually reduced.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Zuora credit memo apply job read
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job envelope. Completion carries operation, method, path, status, correlation_id and data (Zuora's response body as received).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Queued is not completion. On completion relay HTTP status, ids and states exactly as Zuora returned them; a write or delete may have changed vendor state, so do not replay it automatically.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read an asynchronous credit memo apply job (GET /v1/credit-memos/apply-async-jobs/{applyAsyncJobId}): its status and errors.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params is input that does not match Zuora's documented shape: a bad identifier, header value or query pairing, a body missing a required field, or an unreadable or wrongly typed upload file. zuora.permission_denied is the vendor's 403 for the registered OAuth client's role, with Zuora's reason. zuora.validation_failed is a vendor 4xx or an HTTP 200 carrying success false, with Zuora's reasons. zuora.object_not_found, zuora.rate_limited and zuora.api_error map Zuora's answer; zuora.auth_failed is a 401 credential failure.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct the parameters, or ask the Zuora administrator to grant the OAuth client's role the Billing permission the reason names, or enable the vendor feature it names (for example Invoice Settlement or billing document file generation). Read current vendor state with the matching get or list verb before retrying a write; pass an idempotency_key where offered. Back off on rate limits.
